parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const raw = $('Parse Created Booking').first().json.attendeePhone; const digits = (raw || '').replace(/\D/g,''); return 'https://api.followupboss.com/v1/people?phone=' + encodeURIComponent(digits) + '&limit=1'; })() }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const pid = Number($('Build Showing Row').first().json.personId || 0); if (!pid) return JSON.stringify({ body: 'no personId', personId: 0 }); return JSON.stringify({ personId: pid, body: 'Showing scheduled: ' + new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/New_York', weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true }).format(new Date($('Build Showing Row').first().json.showing_time)) + ' at ' + $('Build Showing Row').first().json.property_address }); })() }}

parameters.body: ={{ 'appKey=' + encodeURIComponent($('Calc Code Window (Created)').first().json.appKey) + '&accessToken=' + encodeURIComponent($('Populife - Get Token (Created)').first().json.data.accessToken) + '&lockId=' + encodeURIComponent($('Calc Code Window (Created)').first().json.populifeLockId) + '&startDate=' + encodeURIComponent($('Calc Code Window (Created)').first().json.startDate) + '&endDate=' + encodeURIComponent($('Calc Code Window (Created)').first().json.endDate) + '&timeZone=' + encodeURIComponent($('Calc Code Window (Created)').first().json.tzOffset) + '&alias=' + encodeURIComponent($('Calc Code Window (Created)').first().json.person_name || 'Showing') }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const pid = Number($('Build Showing Row').first().json.personId || 0); if (!pid) return JSON.stringify({ body: 'no personId', personId: 0 }); return JSON.stringify({ personId: pid, body: 'Access code sent: ' + $('Populife - Generate Code (Created)').first().json.data.keyboardPwd + ' for showing at ' + $('Build Showing Row').first().json.property_address + ' on ' + new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/New_York', weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true }).format(new Date($('Build Showing Row').first().json.showing_time)) }); })() }}

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const s={}; $('Read Settings (Delete Old Code)').all().forEach(i=>{if(i.json.key)s[i.json.key]=i.json.value}); return 'https://open.populife.co/api/auth/access_token/get?appKey=' + s.populife_app_key + '&appSecret=' + s.populife_app_secret; })() }}
